description: Analyze the algebraic structure of known champion TMs by decomposing their transition functions into composable modules (counters, sweepers, shifters) and identifying common structural motifs.
mathematical_formalization: Decompose delta: Q x Sigma -> Q x Sigma x {L,R} into semi-group of partial functions
implementation_hypothesis: Build a catalog of TM sub-modules from known champions; enumerate novel compositions of these modules in 6-state space
experiment_seed: Extract modules from top-5 known BB(6) candidates and enumerate all valid 6-state compositions
